```{r}
# wrangle SAMHSA data about alcohol use disorder, mental illness, and major depressive episodes from the years 2015-2016, 2018-2019, 2021-2022, 2023-2024 
# Kylie and Jerry found data and planned wrangling steps, Leyna coded
```

```{r}
#| label: setup

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-wrangle-code
 
# Data import, `skip` to take out the initial lines that aren't actual data

dataset_list <- list(
  alc_use_15_16 = read_csv("../raw-data/15-16-alcohol-use.csv", skip = 5),
  dep_ep_15_16 = read_csv("../raw-data/15-16-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_15_16 = read_csv("../raw-data/15-16-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5),
  
  alc_use_18_19 = read_csv("../raw-data/18-19-alcohol-use.csv", skip = 5),
  dep_ep_18_19 = read_csv("../raw-data/18-19-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_18_19 = read_csv("../raw-data/18-19-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5),
  
  alc_use_21_22 = read_csv("../raw-data/21-22-alcohol-use.csv", skip = 5),
  dep_ep_21_22 = read_csv("../raw-data/21-22-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_21_22 = read_csv("../raw-data/21-22-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5),
  
  alc_use_23_24 = read_csv("../raw-data/23-24-alcohol-use.csv", skip = 5),
  dep_ep_23_24 = read_csv("../raw-data/23-24-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_23_24 = read_csv("../raw-data/23-24-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5)
  )

# Data wrangling

# vector of all CI columns to be deleted
CI_col <- c("12 or Older 95% CI (Lower)", "12 or Older 95% CI (Upper)",
               "12-17 95% CI (Lower)", "12-17 95% CI (Upper)", 
               "18-25 95% CI (Lower)", "18-25 95% CI (Upper)",
               "26 or Older 95% CI (Lower)", "26 or Older 95% CI (Upper)",
               "18 or Older 95% CI (Lower)", "18 or Older 95% CI (Upper)",
               "95% CI (Lower)", "95% CI (Upper)", "18+ 95% CI (Lower)",
               "18+ 95% CI (Upper)", "26+ 95% CI (Lower)", "26+ 95% CI (Upper)")

dataset_list1 <- lapply(dataset_list, function(df) {
  # go through each dataset
  # remove "Order" column & keep "State" 
  df |> select(-"Order", 
               "State", 
               # remove any of the columns that match the ones listed in CI_col
               -any_of(trash_col))
})

# group datasets by year into lists
dataset_15_16 <- dataset_list1[1:3]
dataset_18_19 <- dataset_list1[4:6]
dataset_21_22 <- dataset_list1[7:9]
dataset_23_24 <- dataset_list1[10:12]

# add corresponding year to the end of variables in each dataset
# except for the state variable
dataset_15_16 <- lapply(dataset_15_16, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 15_16"), -"State")
})

dataset_18_19 <- lapply(dataset_18_19, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 18_19"), -"State")
})

dataset_21_22 <- lapply(dataset_21_22, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 21_22"), -"State")
})

dataset_23_24 <- lapply(dataset_23_24, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 23_24"), -"State")
})

list2env(c(dataset_15_16, dataset_18_19, dataset_21_22, dataset_23_24), 
         envir = .GlobalEnv)

```
